# Chart Donut

```tsx
import { ChartDonut } from "@s0l/design-system"
```

A donut chart with its Legend. Mirrors the Figma Chart Donut: give it `items`, and the slices, the Legend and the center follow the values. The width follows the container.

## Example

From the Storybook story; names like `args` or `label` are the story controls.

```tsx
renderChart(allArgs, itemCount, legend)
```

## Figma notes

Mirrors the Figma Chart Donut: the ring, the Label + Value in its center and the Legend. Items are not variants here: they come from `items`, so any amount works, and the slices, the Legend and the center all follow the values.
Each slice is a share of the ring, clockwise from the top. Where the items don't reach `total` the Track shows, as in Items=1.
`valueType` says what the values are. The Legend shows them in full and the center abbreviates them: 10 mil, R$ 11 mi, 12 bi.
The width follows the container. With the Legend on the right and no room for it, the Legend moves below the ring. Chart Donut X-Small is `size="x-small"`: one item, shown as the ring and its share, for tight spots. `headingLength` and `labelLength` are the characters of Heading/Medium and of Label/Medium that fit inside each ring. Longer values step down a size.

## Props

Documented props only; every component also accepts the props of the element or Base UI part it renders (`className`, events, ARIA…).

`ChartDonutProps`:

| Prop | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | `ChartDonutItem[]` | Figma Items. X-Small only shows the first one. |
| `total?` | `number` | The Total: what a full ring stands for, and what the center shows. By default, the sum of the items. Where they don't reach it, the Track shows. |
| `legend?` | `"bottom" \| "right"` | Figma Legend. |
| `size?` | `ChartDonutSize` | Figma Size. X-Small has no Label and no Legend, and shows one item. |
| `label?` | `React.ReactNode` | Figma Label, in the center. |
| `value?` | `React.ReactNode` | Figma Value, in the center. By default, the Total. At X-Small, which has no room for it, the share of its item. A number is abbreviated like the Total. |
| `valueType?` | `ChartDonutValueType` | What the values are. As `percent`, 75 reads 75%. |
| `currency?` | `string` | The ISO code of the money, for `valueType="currency"`. |

## Types

`ChartDonutItem`, `ChartDonutProps`, `ChartDonutSize`, `ChartDonutValueType`

## Rules

- Import `ChartDonut` from `@s0l/design-system`. Do not rebuild it with plain HTML and Tailwind classes.
- Style it through its props and variants first. Use `className` only for layout (margin, width, grid placement), never to change its colors, typography or radius.
- Colors come from the S0L tokens; see [color](../foundations/color.md).
